name: tool-dev-notebuddy
description: Care for the authenticated user’s lifelong pet. Python rules are authoritative.

tools.name: game
tools.description: Read or care for your pet. Never choose a user or provide game state. Reuse request_id when retrying one action.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: One game action. status reads current progress; start creates your first partner.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pet name, only for start. Up to 24 characters.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Response language. Defaults to English. Presentation only; reuse request_id when switching language on a retry.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Stable ID for one action, reused on transport retries. Omit to use the host invoke ID.
